pilot.title: Pet Sitting Business Operations Tracker for Solo Operators — Stage 6 Pilot
pilot.description: A digital spreadsheet/template bundle for solo and very small pet-sitting or dog-walking businesses that need one structured place to manage client and pet records, service rates, bookings and visits, payments and unpaid balances, expenses and mileage, follow-up tasks, and a compact operating dashboard. The pilot deliberately excludes legal contracts, tax or legal advice, veterinary or medical decision support, and any compliance guarantee.
risks: Current evidence establishes a real pet-care operator market and current competing spreadsheet offers, but does not prove demand for this exact product before a genuine sales test.
The Etsy niche has multiple current competing business trackers, so differentiation and listing execution matter.
Revenue and cost figures are planning assumptions, not observed commercial outcomes.
The product must stay within organization/business tracking and must not drift into legal, tax, veterinary, medical, or compliance advice.

targetCustomer.persona: A solo pet sitter, dog walker, or very small independent pet-care operator who personally manages recurring client and pet information, bookings/visits, rates, payments, expenses, mileage, and follow-up work.
painPoints: Operational information is easily split across messages, notes, calendars, payment records, and ad-hoc spreadsheets.
The operator needs a simple way to see upcoming work, completed visits, paid/unpaid balances, expenses, mileage, and basic profit in one workflow.
A solo operator may prefer a one-time spreadsheet/toolkit over another recurring software subscription.
buyingTriggers: Growing number of recurring clients or visits
Difficulty tracking unpaid jobs or business expenses
Need to consolidate client, pet, booking, and financial records
Preference for an offline or low-overhead business administration tool

channels.rationale: Current Etsy listings demonstrate an active category of pet-sitting and dog-walking business spreadsheets and toolkits. The pilot can be validated without paid advertising first.
Direct qualitative feedback can validate workflow pain points and product usefulness before any paid acquisition is authorized.

evidence.sourceName: Pet Sitters International — 2026 State of the Industry statistics
evidence.originalExcerpt: PSI's 2026 survey reports 2025 average U.S. member-business gross revenue of $112,423, up from $100,537 in 2023.
evidence.termsOfUseNote: Public industry-statistics webpage manually reviewed for factual research; no personal data collected.
evidence.statement: PSI's 2026 industry survey reports meaningful operating scale and revenue in professional pet-sitting businesses, supporting the existence of a real target-customer market.

evidence.sourceName: American Pet Products Association — 2026 State of the Industry
evidence.originalExcerpt: APPA reports U.S. pet-industry expenditures of $158 billion in 2025, projected at $165 billion in 2026, with 95 million pet-owning households in 2025.
evidence.termsOfUseNote: Public industry report page manually reviewed for high-level market context; no personal data collected.
evidence.statement: The broader U.S. pet economy remains large and growing, providing market context for businesses serving pet owners.

evidence.sourceName: Etsy listing — Pet Sitting Client Tracker Spreadsheet
evidence.originalExcerpt: A current $11.99 digital workbook listing covers clients and pets, bookings, paid/unpaid status, expenses, mileage, and a business dashboard.
evidence.termsOfUseNote: Public marketplace listing manually reviewed as competitive/category evidence; no buyer or seller personal data retained.
evidence.statement: A current Etsy competitor offers a pet-sitting business spreadsheet with the same core operational categories, demonstrating direct category competition and comparable feature expectations.

evidence.sourceName: Etsy listing — Pet Sitting Business Spreadsheet / Dog Walking Booking Tracker
evidence.originalExcerpt: A current $19.99 workbook listing includes client/pet records, services, bookings, visits, invoices/payments, expenses, mileage, and a weekly dashboard for solo operators and small teams.
evidence.termsOfUseNote: Public marketplace listing manually reviewed as competitive/category evidence; no buyer or seller personal data retained.
evidence.statement: A second current Etsy competitor confirms that integrated booking, visit, payment, expense, mileage, and dashboard workflows are established features in this digital-product niche.

evidence.sourceName: Etsy Help — Fees and Taxes for Selling on Etsy
evidence.originalExcerpt: Etsy currently states a $0.20 USD listing fee and a 6.5% transaction fee on the total order amount, with payment processing charged separately.
evidence.termsOfUseNote: Official Etsy Help page manually reviewed for current marketplace-fee assumptions; no personal data collected.
evidence.statement: Etsy's current published listing and transaction fees provide authoritative marketplace-cost inputs for pilot planning.

evidence.originalExcerpt: Etsy's current country table lists Cyprus Etsy Payments processing at 4% of the sale price plus €0.30 per order.
evidence.termsOfUseNote: Official Etsy Help page manually reviewed for Cyprus payment-processing assumptions; no personal data collected.
evidence.statement: The current Cyprus Etsy Payments processing rate is published by Etsy and can be used as a high-confidence fee assumption for the pilot.
